title: Children's Eye Care in Fort Myers | Riverside Family Eye Care
metaDescription: Children's eye care in Fort Myers: pediatric exams, first contact lens fittings, back-to-school checks and myopia management. Vision and medical plans accepted.
h1: Children's eye care in Fort Myers
html:
One place in Fort Myers for every stage of your child's vision - gentle eye exams from age 4 to 5, their first contact lenses when they're ready, back-to-school checks, and a myopia program that helps slow nearsightedness as they grow. We check their eyes year after year, so nothing slips through the cracks between visits.

Request Appointment or call 239-500-2020.

The four kinds of kids' care, all in one place

Pick the exact care your child needs and book it in one step, instead of hunting across the site.

  • Pediatric Eye Exams: thorough, patient exams for kids from age 4 to 5, plus school-vision screening that catches what a quick classroom check can miss.
  • Kids' Contact Lenses: careful first-contact fittings with hands-on handling lessons, usually around ages 10 to 12, so a nervous first-timer leaves knowing how to put lenses in and take them back out.
  • Back-to-School Eye Exams: checks so your child starts the school year seeing the board clearly.
  • Myopia Management: a program using atropine or multifocal lenses to help slow a child's nearsightedness while their eyes are still growing.

Following your child's vision through the school years

Here, our optometrists follow your child's vision from the very first exam through the school years.

Bring your card, we accept vision and medical plans

Book your child's eye exam online, or call and talk to a real person. We accept vision and medical insurance plans, so bring your card and call for pricing, and we will help you figure out what applies to your family.

Coverage varies by plan, so call and we will walk you through what yours covers. See our Insurance page for the plans we accept.
